brief:
The UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees warned of escalating hazards at 18 locations across Gaza, including displacement shelters, as heavy rain and wind intensify, Shehab Wire reported.

The agency cited compounding risks at the sites amid worsening weather conditions. UNRWA did not specify the nature of the threatened disaster or provide details on how many people shelter at the affected locations.

title: UNRWA warns of disaster threatening 18 Gaza sites
